preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner
Attacker must hold some INCOME tokens to sell

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setExtraFeeOnSell() with a value greater than 25 (e.g., 50) to set an excessive sell fee. Then sell tokens through the DEX pair to trigger the high fee mechanism, which will transfer a larger portion of the sale proceeds to the contract (and subsequently to marketing/dividends). The owner can then withdraw funds via SafeToken functions or benefit from the fee redistribution.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The INCOME contract allows the owner to set an extraFeeOnSell that adds additional percentage fees on sell transactions. By setting this to a high value (e.g., 50) and then selling tokens, a large portion of the sale (64% total with base fees) goes to the contract. As the owner, the attacker can then withdraw these accumulated funds via SafeToken functions.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner. 2. Set extraFeeOnSell to 50. 3. Acquire INCOME tokens. 4. Sell tokens through the DEX pair to trigger the high fee mechanism. 5. Withdraw accumulated BNB from the contract.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.prank to impersonate owner. 2. Call setExtraFeeOnSell(50). 3. Transfer INCOME tokens from owner to attacker. 4. Approve router to spend attacker's tokens. 5. Call swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens to sell tokens. 6. As owner, call withdrawBNB to extract accumulated BNB.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The contract may already have extraFeeOnSell set to a high value. Even without owner privileges, if extraFeeOnSell is high, selling tokens will incur massive fees that get redistributed to token holders via dividends. As a token holder, we can benefit from this redistribution.
attempts.attack_strategy: 1. Check if extraFeeOnSell is already high. 2. Buy INCOME tokens to become a token holder. 3. Sell tokens to trigger the high fee mechanism. 4. Receive dividend distributions as a token holder. 5. Claim dividends to profit.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Read extraFeeOnSell value from contract. 2. Use BNB to buy INCOME tokens via the DEX. 3. Sell some tokens back to trigger fees. 4. Process dividends to receive our share. 5. Verify attacker's BNB balance increased.
attempts.failure_reflection: The previous PoC failed because the contract owner is address(0), meaning ownership was renounced. We cannot impersonate the zero address or call owner-only functions. Need an alternative approach that doesn't require owner privileges.
